members.description: Number of members in the team.

questions.question: List IDs of allied guards with readiness above 0.5.
questions.oracle: SELECT id FROM teams WHERE standing = 'ally' AND role = 'guard' AND readiness > 0.5

questions.question: List hostile team IDs with at least four members.
questions.oracle: SELECT id FROM teams WHERE standing = 'hostile' AND members >= 4

questions.question: How many allied members are there in total?
questions.oracle: SELECT SUM(members) FROM teams WHERE standing = 'ally'

questions.question: What is the whole-team supply total for teams with readiness at least 0.6?
questions.oracle: SELECT SUM(group_supply) FROM teams WHERE readiness >= 0.6

questions.question: What is the average readiness of medic teams?
questions.oracle: SELECT AVG(readiness) FROM teams WHERE role = 'medic'

questions.question: What is the smallest per-member supply value?
questions.oracle: SELECT MIN(unit_supply) FROM teams

questions.question: What is the sum of group_supply for the three teams with largest group_supply?
questions.oracle: SELECT SUM(group_supply) FROM teams ORDER BY group_supply DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: How many scout teams are neutral?
questions.oracle: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teams WHERE role = 'scout' AND standing = 'neutral'

members.description: Number of members in the team.

questions.question: List IDs of allied guards with readiness above 0.5.

questions.question: List hostile team IDs with at least four members.
questions.oracle: SELECT id FROM teams WHERE standing = 'hostile' AND members >= 4

questions.question: How many allied members are there in total?
questions.oracle: SELECT SUM(members) FROM teams WHERE standing = 'ally'

questions.question: What is the whole-team supply total for teams with readiness at least 0.6?
questions.oracle: SELECT SUM(group_supply) FROM teams WHERE readiness >= 0.6

questions.question: What is the average readiness of medic teams?
questions.oracle: SELECT AVG(readiness) FROM teams WHERE role = 'medic'

questions.question: What is the smallest per-member supply value?
questions.oracle: SELECT MIN(unit_supply) FROM teams

questions.question: What is the sum of group_supply for the three teams with largest group_supply?
questions.oracle: SELECT SUM(group_supply) FROM teams ORDER BY group_supply DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: How many scout teams are neutral?
questions.oracle: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teams WHERE role = 'scout' AND standing = 'neutral'

access.description: Current access state; only open paths are traversable.

party_size.description: Members in the party for this route.

risk.description: Native route risk score from zero to one.

questions.question: List open path IDs with risk at most 0.3.

questions.question: What is the largest travel duration among open routes?

questions.question: What is the average travel duration for ridge routes?

questions.question: What is the sum of party_size across open ridge or ruins routes?
questions.oracle: SELECT SUM(party_size) FROM paths WHERE access = 'open' AND zone IN ('ridge','ruins')

paths.description: Native game rows; all columns describe the same row.

access.description: Current access state; only open paths are traversable.

party_size.description: Members in the party for this route.

party_toll.description: Total toll for the entire party, party_size * toll_per_member.

risk.description: Native route risk score from zero to one.

questions.question: List open path IDs with risk at most 0.3.
questions.oracle: SELECT id FROM paths WHERE access = 'open' AND risk <= 0.3

questions.question: List open path IDs with zero toll per member.
questions.oracle: SELECT id FROM paths WHERE access = 'open' AND toll_per_member = 0

questions.question: What is the total whole-party toll across open routes?
questions.oracle: SELECT SUM(party_toll) FROM paths WHERE access = 'open'

questions.question: What is the largest travel duration among open routes?
questions.oracle: SELECT MAX(minutes) FROM paths WHERE access = 'open'

questions.question: What is the average travel duration for ridge routes?
questions.oracle: SELECT AVG(minutes) FROM paths WHERE zone = 'ridge'

questions.question: What is the sum of party_toll for the three routes with largest party_toll?
questions.oracle: SELECT SUM(party_toll) FROM paths ORDER BY party_toll DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: How many locked paths have risk at least 0.5?
questions.oracle: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paths WHERE access = 'locked' AND risk >= 0.5

questions.question: What is the sum of party_size across open ridge or ruins routes?
questions.oracle: SELECT SUM(party_size) FROM paths WHERE access = 'open' AND zone IN ('ridge','ruins')
